text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The NHK Mile Cup
was all anyone could talk about regarding Rhein Kraft!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wah... how strange. Somehow the atmosphere feels a little different from a regular race...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft, huh. If I win,
does that make me the new Mile Queen or something?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, Craft has always felt, like...
a single blossom standing out within the Tiara, you know?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Has a Tiara route girl ever won this race before?
Hope she doesn't get overwhelmed."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, ahaha...
Now they're worrying about me~

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, yeah!
I trained properly, so I'll be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I'll win here...!
And blaze a brand new trail!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
No, no, she looks totally fine. Besides,
there are a few other girls on the Tiara route, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: With Daring Heart—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Seems like everyone's attention
has completely shifted to craft, huh.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Her brilliance at the Oka Sho truly was something—
even I was a little caught off guard!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"So please, just think of me as a dark horse, okay?
It will make for a far more dramatic race, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: And Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I never thought I'd end up running in this race.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no, I was merely joking.
...Though Line Kraft looked a little startled.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“Still, part of me wanted to feel her success
right by her side, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
In any case, if we're going to do it, we'll do it thoroughly.
As a race leading into the Oaks—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I shall steal away
every single bit of this stage...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A lightning-fast mile showdown!
The curtain rises on the "NHK Mile Cup"!
